planets.name: TOI-2015 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2015 with a 3.35-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-2015 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-2015. Its orbit and size follow Barkaoui et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
